title: The section-ring restriction-and-division map is bijective
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $S$ be its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $s$ have positive degree $d$, and let $U$ be the nonvanishing open of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. If a ring map $\varphi:S_{(s)}\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ satisfies $\varphi(\xi/s^n)\,s^n|_U=\xi|_U$ for every homogeneous numerator $\xi$ of degree $nd$, then $\varphi$ is bijective. Neither ampleness nor affineness is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 01PW(2), degree-zero localization, used in Lemma 01Q1; equivalently coherent.tex Lemma 09MR with p=0

proof.text: Apply exists_sectionFraction_nonvanishing_equiv to M=L.tensorPow d, the structure module, and the section s.val d. Its compactness and quasi-separatedness assumptions are precisely the stated ones; tensor powers and the structure module supply invertibility and quasi-coherence. Identify its nonvanishing open with U by equality of their underlying sets. Compose with the Veronese section-fraction equivalence and the unit-sections equivalence to obtain an additive equivalence e from homogeneous localization to functions on U.

The private ring_power_of lemma proves by induction that the nth ring power of a homogeneous section is the direct-sum injection of its nth tensor power transported along tensorPowMulIso inverse. The successor step expands tensorPowMulIso, tensors sections, and cancels the degree cast. The private veroneseIso_power lemma evaluates this identity in degree n*d and cancels the tensor-power isomorphism. Naturality supplies the same identity after restriction to U.

Use nonvanishing_section_trivializes to make s a free generator on U; its tensor powers are free generators too. For an arbitrary homogeneous localization element choose a fraction representative using Away.mk_surjective. Transport hphi through the numerator tensor-power isomorphism. Apply the left unitor to the section-fraction equivalence formula and cancel its inverse. Both equations identify multiplication of the functions phi(q) and e(q) by the same tensor-power generator with the same restricted numerator. Cancel that generator to prove phi(q)=e(q). Function extensionality then transports the bijectivity of e to phi.

theorem sectionRing_localization_bijective
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (s : sectionRingGrade L d)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d))
    (φ : CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val) ⟶
      Γ(X, U))
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
      (φ (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
          ξ.val ξ.property)) •
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) =
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • d))) :
    Function.Bijective φ
